==Description==
'''MEGA Servers''' were survival servers, but with a maximum of six (previously eight) people per server. They offered the same [[maps]] as survival servers. Anyone could join a '''MEGA Server'''.
'''MEGA Servers''' were ideal for people who wanted to play with lots of people or wanted to triumph a really difficult [[Maps|map]] more easily. Any placement limits for individual [[towers]], like the [[Military Base]] or [[Ranger]], were the same in a '''MEGA Server'''. The same rewards were given out at the end of the game in '''MEGA Servers''' compared to normal servers. You could also obtain the [[Cowboy]] in [[Badlands]] Fallen mode in a '''MEGA Server'''.

However, there were some differences in '''MEGA Servers'''. The most noticeable difference being that all players could only place 16 towers down instead of the usual 20-40, if there were 5+ people in the server. Additionally, the sell costs of [[towers]] were less than expected and less money was awarded per player after a wave ends. This meant that you needed to adjust your strategy, especially early-game. Additionally, certain enemies had increased health, such as the [[Heavy]].

== Trivia ==
*Prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], all enemies continued the linear progression of health increase from 2 players onwards, similar to survival servers.
**After the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], health increase was similar, though it only applied to '''MEGA Servers''', not survival servers. This was removed on the 26th of January 2020 and replaced with tower cost scaling.
**However, health scaling was added back for final bosses on the 11th of February 2020 and certain other enemies after the 4th of March 2020.
*Prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], only players that were {{Level|15+}} had access to these servers.
**Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], all towers and upgrades were 20% more expensive in '''MEGA Servers'''.
**In the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]], '''MEGA Servers''' had a {{Level|15+}} requirement, but due to a bug you were still able to enter '''MEGA Servers''' without being {{Level|15+}}.
*You could not have triggered the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]] on a '''MEGA Server''' via the time requirement.
**However, if 4 or less players were left in the server before wave 40 was completed, then you could have still triggered the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] via the time requirement.
*[[Maps]] completed on a '''MEGA Server''' counted towards the removed [[Platinum Crate]].
*Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]], '''MEGA Servers''' could hold up to eight players.
